title: Word bank
intro: These are high-use academic words that often appear in SAT-style passages and in Words in Context answer choices. Level 1 words are common in academic reading; level 4 words are the sophisticated choices you meet in the hardest questions. Learn each word through its example sentence, and notice the shade of meaning, not just a synonym.

words.definition: to leave behind or give up completely

words.definition: to become less strong or intense
